summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the board's adoption of the 2026 Share Incentive Plan No. 2 on August 15, 2026, authorizing up to 14,625,000,000,000 Class A ordinary shares for future awards over a ten-year term. No awards have been granted under the preceding 2026 Plan No. 1. This is a routine equity incentive plan adoption, not a special-situation transaction. The filing includes the full plan document as Exhibit 99.1 and standard signatures. There are no deal terms, prices, premiums, or strategic actions; the event is purely administrative and compensatory in nature.
